Game Overview

In Boxes Wizard 2, the core idea is straightforward: step into a wizard's shoes in Boxes Wizard 2, a nostalgic pixel art platformer where teleportation and box manipulation are your keys to mastery. Tackle 40 cleverly designed levels, blending strategy and timing in a delightful retro setting, challenging both your magic skills and your puzzle-solving prowess.
